translate_messages_to_responses_input: translate a list of Anthropic user and assistant messages to OpenAI Responses API input items
translate_tools_to_responses_api: translate Anthropic tool definitions to OpenAI Responses API function tool format
translate_tool_choice_to_responses_api: translate Anthropic tool_choice to OpenAI Responses API tool_choice format
translate_request: translate a full Anthropic /v1/messages request dict to OpenAI Responses API kwargs
translate_response: translate an OpenAI Responses API response back to Anthropic /v1/messages response format
